annotation_method: Visible bounds marked by the implementing agent on original nearest-neighbour enlarged JPEG pixels before runtime development. No detector proposals, output SVG or reference SVG used. This is not an independent human annotation audit.
family_policy: Two new compositions were frozen before runtime edits. First transfer failed 0/2; both originals were then disclosed as development and used for generic raster fixes. Subsequent success on these originals is development evidence, not new held-out family acceptance. All descendants stay development.
